One install line, and every dsh agent "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"gets the full DonSeTch suite: fetch, search, and crawl with browser-grade stealth, keyless engines, "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"BYOK providers, and an auto-updating native binary. No API key required to start."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` (bundle plugins activate on the next boot). On first start the plugin downloads th"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"e correct DonSeTch binary for your platform from GitHub Releases, verifies its SHA256 against the re"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"lease sidecar, and registers the tools. That is the whole setup: no API key, no config file."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Add the `dsh-plugin` topic to your repo mentions: this repo is already on it. The plugin also works "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"in headless profiles:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- `donsetch_web_fetch`: one URL to full markdown, browser-grade rendering and stealth where needed
-"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" `donsetch_web_search`: keyless engines out of the box, or your own keys via BYOK providers (Exa, Ta"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"vily, Serper, SerpApi, SerpBase, Bright Data, TinyFish, plus plugin adapters)
- `donsetch_web_crawl`"},{"id":"p10s4","text":": whole-site crawling with sitemap discovery
- `donsetch_status`: self-diagnostics (degraded daemons"},{"id":"p10s5","text":" get one automatically)
- Native `web_search`: the harness's own web_search tool routes through DonS"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"eTch (the bundle patch selects the `donsetch` search provider), so ordinary searches work with no De"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"le patch selects the `donsetch` search provider), so ordinary searches work with no DeepSeek API key"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The tools are registered in-process on the harness tool registry, not as `mcp__*` imports, so they f"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"low through dsh's permission, timeout, and cancellation pipeline like any native tool, and they show"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" call/result cards in the Web workbench."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Why it is not just an MCP config"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"dsh ships a built-in MCP client. Pointing it at `donsetch mcp` works, but this plugin is the first-c"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"uilt-in MCP client. Pointing it at `donsetch mcp` works, but this plugin is the first-class version:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| | built-in MCP config | this plugin |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Install | you write a config row | one plugin add |
| Binary download + SHA256 verify | manual ins"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"tall | automatic |
| Auto-updates with donsetch releases | never | yes, throttled, swappable between"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" calls |
| Tool names | `mcp__donsetch__...` | `donsetch_...` |
| Config changes from the CLI | rest"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"art everything | live daemon restart on config file change |
| Workbench cards | generic | per-tool "},{"id":"p15s5","text":"call/result summaries |
| Status + doctor for the agent | none | `donsetch_status` |
| Harness schem"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"a contract | none | parameters comply with the enforced raw JSON Schema contract |
| Correctness gat"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"e in CI | none | the plugin runs inside a real dsh ToolRuntime on every push |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## How customization works"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The plugin uses the exact same config file the standard DonSeTch CLI uses, so every part of DonSeTch"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"'s normal customization applies unchanged:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"CLI changes land in the live dsh plugin within seconds: the plugin watches the config file and swaps"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" the daemon without a dsh restart."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"All defaults are sensible; the plugin works with zero configuration. Options come from the bundle pa"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"tch (edit `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` to override) plus environment variables."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| option | default | description |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| `toolPrefix` | `donsetch` | Model-facing tool name prefix, `[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,16}` |
| `channel` | `s"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"table` | Update channel: `stable` (releases) or `latest` (includes prereleases) |
| `autoUpdate` | `"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"true` | Check GitHub Releases and swap in newer verified binaries between calls |
| `updateIntervalH"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ours` | `24` | Minimum gap between update checks |
| `callTimeoutMs` | `180000` | Per-tool-call time"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"out |
| `bootTimeoutMs` | `20000` | Daemon initialize + tools/list timeout |
| `fallbackToPath` | `t"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"rue` | Use a `donsetch` already on PATH when the download fails (degraded mode, told honestly in `do"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"nsetch_status`) |
| `pinnedVersion` | current | donsetch release a fresh install pins (floor, not ce"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"tatus`) |
| `pinnedVersion` | current | donsetch release a fresh install pins (floor, not ceiling) |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Environment: `DONSETCH_DSH_PREFIX`, `DONSETCH_DSH_CHANNEL`, `DONSETCH_DSH_AUTOUPDATE=off`, `DONSETCH"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"_BIN` (path to a local donsetch binary), `DONSETCH_DSH_CACHE_DIR`."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Patch-layer example (`$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`, later layers win):"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Updates"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Two-layer update story. The plugin glue is a bundle: re-running `dsh plugin add` against a newer pin"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" (or letting the repository panel track the branch) keeps it current. The donsetch binary updates it"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"self: on a throttled schedule it checks GitHub Releases on your channel, and when a newer release ap"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"pears it downloads, SHA256-verifies against the release sidecar, and swaps the daemon between in-fli"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"ght calls. A failed verify aborts the install and keeps the current binary; nothing partial ever rep"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"laces a working daemon."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The baseline DonSeTch pin auto-tracks published releases every 6 hours."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Reliability notes"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- The daemon runs supervised (`donsetch mcp --supervised`), so crashes restart transparently and the"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" next tool call revives cleanly.
- Cancellations reach the real daemon (`notifications/cancelled`), "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"the in-flight fetch or crawl actually stops.
